question: Should OpenClaw accept `currentTokenCount` plus the new token-budget helpers as a stable public ContextEngine/plugin SDK contract now, or fold this into the broader assemble metadata RFC at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82137?
rationale: The patch is a public plugin API expansion, not just internal plumbing, and the related assemble-metadata RFC means the permanent contract shape needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
options.body: Approve the `currentTokenCount` API now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

options.title: Fold Into RFC
options.body: Pause or close this PR and handle token counts together with the broader provenance/internal-event assemble metadata design.

options.title: Keep Private For Now
options.body: Avoid adding SDK exports until a maintainer-owned plugin API shape and compatibility plan are settled.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Contract After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the `currentTokenCount` API now, then require SDK baseline regeneration and redacted live long-session/context-engine proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on this exact context-engine budget and API area.
